long_biography.plain_text:
Robert Conconi’s children helped introduce him to youth homelessness charities. His daughter Victoria and son Adam volunteered at Covenant House Vancouver while in high school, prompting their parents to learn more about its work. Visits to the facilities and conversations with staff grew into a partnership, including a challenge that matched donations from other supporters.

Conconi brings business experience to his charitable work alongside funding. He and Diane seek to help organizations identify needs, improve their processes and become more self-sufficient. His approach asks for time, practical knowledge and connections as well as money, with the aim of leaving partners better able to serve their communities.
